serverInfo.description: StartupMKT is a startup discovery platform and acquisitions marketplace for micro-SaaS and AI ventures. It helps founders monetize what they built: compare startups and AI tools, read pricing teardowns, browse startups for sale, and follow the latest verified funding rounds. You built it. Now make money.
